sql:
SELECT p.PromotionCategory AS PromotionCategory,
       sum(f.DiscountAmount) AS TotalDiscountAmount,
       sum(f.SalesAmount) AS TotalSalesAmount,
       sum(f.DiscountAmount) * 100.0 / nullif(sum(f.SalesAmount) + sum(f.DiscountAmount), 0) AS AverageDiscountPercent
FROM retail.FactOnlineSales AS f
INNER JOIN retail.DimPromotion AS p ON f.PromotionKey = p.PromotionKey
WHERE f.PromotionKey != 1
GROUP BY p.PromotionCategory
ORDER BY TotalDiscountAmount DESC
